skillGroups.title: Rebirth

entries.title: While Theophany is active
entries.descriptionTemplate: The other Awakeners temporarily leave the field. Theophany fights alone with his own HP, is immune to control, and prevents State and Symptom Card generation. Relic effects, Arithmetica, Aliemus, Keyflare, and most buffs and Realm effects are suspended. {STR}, {Alert}, {Counter}, DMG Amplification, and {Aequor} effects remain.

entries.title: Rebirth bonuses
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Each {Erosion} stack removed at rebirth grants +80% Max HP.
Each permanent Silver Relic grants +15% ATK and +3% DEF; other permanent Relics count as two.
Each {Etched Memory} at rebirth independently increases {Fixed DMG} multipliers by 2.5%, and {Temporary STR} reduction, {Tentacle DMG}, and Shield multipliers by 0.5% each.
For every six skill levels gained on Godking, all Theophany abilities gain one level.

skillGroups.intro: Base values use the selected stats, before combat bonuses from Relics, {Erosion}, or {Etched Memory}.

skillGroups.title: Asterisms & Orbits

entries.title: Brilliance
entries.descriptionTemplate: The number on an Asterism, I to V. Scutum III is a Scutum with Brilliance 3. Match three numbers or make a run of three to give {Stars Surge} extra hits. Runs work in any play order.

entries.title: Antares
entries.descriptionTemplate: Deals [FixedDamage:Arg1] {Fixed DMG}.

entries.title: Scutum
entries.descriptionTemplate: Deals [FixedDamage:Arg1] {Fixed DMG} and temporarily reduces all enemies' {STR} by [Exhaustion:Arg2].

entries.title: Pleiades
entries.descriptionTemplate: Deals [FixedDamage:Arg1] {Fixed DMG} and adds [TentaclePower:Arg2] to the team's {Tentacle DMG} stat.

skillGroups.intro: Your deck is replaced by 45 Asterisms: three copies of each type at each {Brilliance}. Draw four at the start of each turn. Play them for free into three slots called Orbits. Cards in slots 1, 2, and 3 resolve one, two, and three times respectively. Filling all three slots triggers {Stars Surge} and ends your turn.

skillGroups.title: Stars Surge

entries.title: Base attack
entries.descriptionTemplate: Deal three hits of [FixedDamage:Arg1] {Fixed DMG} before combo bonuses.

entries.title: Extra hits
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Numbers ({Brilliance}): three in a row (I, II, III in any order) add 3 hits; three of the same number add 6.
Types: three different types add 3 hits; three of the same type add 6.
Number and type bonuses stack, for 3–15 hits from the three cards. Antares III, Scutum I, and Pleiades II give 9 hits: 3 base, 3 for the run, and 3 for different types.

entries.title: Per-hit effects
entries.descriptionTemplate:
{Antares}: add [FixedDamage:Arg1] {Fixed DMG} to the hit.
{Scutum}: temporarily reduce all enemies' {STR} by [Exhaustion:Arg2].
{Pleiades}: add [TentaclePower:Arg3] to the team's {Tentacle DMG} stat. This bonus stacks across hits and lasts for the rest of the battle.

entries.title: Same-type effects
entries.descriptionTemplate: Three Antares add [Arg1]% of the team's {Tentacle DMG} to each hit as {Fixed DMG}. Three Scutum grant [Block:Arg2] Shield; three Pleiades independently increase Stars Surge's {Fixed DMG} by 2%.

skillGroups.intro: As Theophany: fill all three {Orbits} to trigger this {Pursuit} and end your turn. After {Morimens}: a random six-hit Surge fires at the start of each turn. It does not end your turn.

skillGroups.title: Runes

entries.title: Alter
entries.descriptionTemplate: This turn, change each Asterism in hand to a random different type without changing its {Brilliance}.

entries.title: Gleam
entries.descriptionTemplate: Raise the {Brilliance} of Asterisms in hand by one this turn.

entries.title: Dim
entries.descriptionTemplate: Lower the {Brilliance} of Asterisms in hand by one this turn.

entries.title: Herald
entries.descriptionTemplate: Discover three Runes. Add one to your hand and set its cost to 0.

entries.title: Beckon
entries.descriptionTemplate: Draw two {Asterisms}.

entries.title: Expand
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gain three different random Runes.

entries.title: Recast
entries.descriptionTemplate: Clear the {Orbits}, discard your hand, draw four Asterisms, and gain two different random Runes.

skillGroups.intro: Add two random Runes to your hand at the start of each turn. Generated Buff Cards and Buff Card options become random Runes added directly to your hand. Runes do not enter the draw or discard pile. Each costs 5 {Etched Memory} and has {Aftershock}: gain 1 {Etched Memory}.

entries.title: Morimens
entries.descriptionTemplate:
When Theophany reaches 0 HP or at the start of the turn after six turns elapse, deal [FixedDamage:Arg1] {Fixed DMG} to all enemies.
The other Awakeners return and Tulu leaves the battle. Restore the original deck, fully heal the team, and restore Relics, Arithmetica, Keyflare, and temporarily disabled buffs and Realm effects.

upgrade.descriptionTemplate:
When Theophany reaches 0 HP or at the start of the turn after six turns elapse, deal [FixedDamage:Arg1] {Fixed DMG} and inflict {Fainted} on all enemies.
The other Awakeners return and Tulu leaves the battle. Restore the original deck, fully heal the team, and restore Relics, Arithmetica, Keyflare, and temporarily disabled buffs and Realm effects.

entries.title: After Departure
entries.descriptionTemplate: A random {Stars Surge} fires automatically at the start of each turn after {Morimens}. It gets the 3 base hits and 3 extra for consecutive {Brilliance}, with no bonus hits from Asterism types. It does not end your turn.

upgradeGroups.title: Enlightens

entries.title: E1 · By This Flesh, I Endure
entries.descriptionTemplate: {Fixed DMG} multiplier +30%, plus 2% per point of Aliemus Regen from Godking, his Wheel, and his Covenant.

entries.title: E2 · By These Stars, I Kindle
entries.descriptionTemplate: {Turn Unique}: After playing two {Asterisms}, the next {Rune} that turn costs 2 less {Etched Memory}.

entries.title: E3 · By This Stele, I Ordain
entries.descriptionTemplate: {Morimens} deals triple damage and inflicts {Fainted} on all enemies.

upgradeGroups.intro: Theophany's E1–E3 unlock with Godking's corresponding Enlightens.

entries.title: Soulforge Aptitude
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Only active in {Astral Reign} stages.
CON, ATK, and DEF +[Arg1]%. Gain [Arg2] Keyflare after playing {Gnosis Rouse} for the first time.
Increases the bonuses per {Etched Memory} stack by [Arg3]%. With 1/2/3 other Lemuria Awakeners, each Awakener gains [Arg6]/[Arg7]/[Arg8] Aliemus whenever {Stars Surge} triggers after Tulu leaves the battle.
